forward_model_inputs.prediction: Only controller command time/value history and own simulated shaper/filter internal states. No recorded gyro, attitude, quaternion, ATTITUDE_TARGET, or BIN desired rate enters prediction.
forward_model_inputs.initialization: Shaper target rate starts from first controller command, target acceleration zero; first-order remainder starts gain times first command. No measured state initialization.
forward_model_inputs.training_teacher_use: Recorded BIN gyro enters optimization residuals only. Held-out gyro enters score only. Recorded ATTITUDE_TARGET enters separate descriptive shaper verification only.

discretization.remainder: alpha=exp(-dt/tau); rate[k]=alpha*rate[k-1]+(1-alpha)*gain*shaped_rate(t[k]-delay); fractional delay uses linear interpolation of simulated target history
discretization.old_aggregate_removed: Native-shaper candidate never calls frozen_pi and does not reuse its tau/delay/ki. Its entire post-shaper remainder is independently refit. Frozen_PI is a comparison baseline only.
discretization.yaw_recommendation: Retain old yaw dynamics; fitted nonlinear yaw is reported for diagnostic comparison only.

effective_rate_model_comparison.heldout_definition: All other completed wind route/hover traces plus system-ID validation1002; no policy performance claim
effective_rate_model_comparison.objective: Mean per-run rate MSE divided by max(0.0025,mean(true_rate^2)); same 3 training traces for both models. Each axis independently fits gain[.85,1.15], tau[.001,.15]s, delay[0,.10]s. Native shaper parameters are fixed from actual logs.
effective_rate_model_comparison.limitations: Rate-only recorded-input prediction omits attitude-correction coupling, torque saturation and aerodynamic gyro disturbances. Frozen_PI is its unsaturated scalar linear rate subsystem, not a rerun of full Fast plant.

findings.validation_limits: Four wind route traces use one fixed policy111 and one environment seed83301 across scenario/interface cases. They are held out from this physical-response fit, not a new independent policy acceptance set.
findings.conclusion: Native shaping is directly observed and its fixed explicit model plus reidentified remainder strongly improves held-out roll/pitch rate prediction while preserving/improving measured small-signal validation. Hard acceleration saturation is sparse and concentrated in goal-activation jumps; smooth braking reversals retain median31ms command-to-shaped sign lag and median63ms command-to-gyro sign lag. Recorded-input rate prediction cannot establish a counterfactual corner-position improvement or any new policy result. Keep yaw aggregate dynamics pending a better validated yaw remainder.
findings.next_step_scope: Promising for a separate new Fast plant namespace plus retraining/revalidation. No parameters installed; physical mass/inertia and all frozen files unchanged.
